name: django
description: Django/Python projects — adds Django template security, pytest, and Python-specific checks

isolation.why: The venv's editable install (.pth) points at the MAIN checkout, so in a git worktree a bare `import djust` resolves to the main source and the tests exercise code that is not the branch under test. Silent: green results about the wrong program.
isolation.verify: import djust; print(djust.__file__)   # MUST print a path under $WORKTREE
do_not_symlink: target/  # 29G cargo cache; concurrent builds collide

regenerate.why: Generated artifacts conflict on every sibling merge. Regenerate them; never hand-merge. After regenerating, re-check the `~NNN KB` claim in CLAUDE.md (`make sizes`) — the pre-commit check-doc-snippets hook enforces it.

security_patterns: mark_safe() with unescaped interpolated values — must use escape() or format_html()
mark_safe inside <script> blocks — HTML escaping is insufficient in JS context, use json.dumps() or allowlist validation
string concatenation in JS contexts — must use json.dumps() for JS string escaping
unescaped user input in Django template tags
auto_reject_triggers: f-string formatting in logger calls — use %s style
missing CHANGELOG.md update for feat/fix PRs

feature.4.action: identify user-configurable values entering unescaped contexts (mark_safe, autoescape off, |safe, JS embedding) — plan input validation for each

feature.5.action: verify test file location is in project's pytest testpaths (check pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options] testpaths)
if generating code/templates: tests must assert on OUTPUT CONTENT (correct syntax, imports, patterns), not just 'it ran without error'
if generating code/templates: verify generated output compiles/parses (python -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open(f).read())' or similar)
no silent exception handling in generated/scaffolded code — use logging not bare except:pass
gate-off: revert the fix, confirm each new test goes RED, restore, confirm GREEN — and record the red/green counts per revision in the PR body

bugfix.3.action: if fix involves user-configurable values in unescaped contexts (mark_safe, autoescape off, |safe, JS embedding), plan input validation

bugfix.4.action: verify test file location is in project's pytest testpaths (check pyproject.toml)

bugfix.5.action: gate-off is mandatory (#1468): every regression case must be shown RED on the revision that carried the defect before the fix is claimed to work. A case that is green on the base revision pins nothing.

merge.why: main carries no merge commits for PRs; a PR author cannot approve their own PR, so drain PRs merge with `--admin` (the human reviews at the milestone level).

artifacts: every matrix-row issue in the bucket is CLOSED
the bucket's matrix rows are struck through
RETRO.md has an entry for the bucket
completion.why: The third one is what `gate_retro_coverage` checks. The second is its precondition: a bucket completed without striking its rows is invisible to every reader, human or script.

test.why: djust canon (#1468): a regression test proves nothing until it has been shown RED on the revision that carried the defect. Record the matrix (base / each intermediate / head) — it is what caught a case that pressed a NON-matching key and therefore could never fail.
